verdict.rationale: A community-quoted log line shows Ollama naming the cause of a GPU fallback ("amdgpu detected, but no compatible rocm library found... falling back to CPU"), so some diagnostic output exists for at least the AMD/ROCm case. That is the only evidence, and it comes from server logs rather than documented user-facing diagnostics. Missing for 10: first-party docs on GPU detection and fallback diagnostics, evidence that this output appears in normal CLI/user output rather than only in logs, coverage of NVIDIA/CUDA and Apple failure modes, and hands-on corroboration that the messages are clear and actionable.
